patch_description: This evolved block implements a compact, highly parameter-efficient ansatz with ring CRX entanglement and hub CRY entanglement, all sharing a single parameter per motif. By reducing per-block parameters from the previous 28+ keys to a fixed 11 unique parameter keys (rz_pre_corner/edge/center, ry_corner/edge/center, crx_ring, cry_hub_edge, rz_post_corner/edge/center), the total parameter count drops to 66 (3 uploads × 2 repeats × 11 keys), matching the more performant 60–66 parameter regimes observed in prior seeds. The design preserves full adjacency constraints (CZ/CNOT around the perimeter; center-to-edge hub gates allowed as (8,1),(8,3),(8,5),(8,7)) and maintains symmetry-based parameter sharing to improve generalization. This approach blends a compact, symmetry-aware pre/post-rotation scheme with a lightweight, shared-parameter ring and hub entanglement, aiming for stronger validation accuracy and reduced train-test gap.
